newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK TECHNODOMIKI 3.12BLN DRS SHARE PLACEMENT DONE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK TECHNODOMIKI 3.12BLN DRS SHARE PLACEMENT DONE.

text.p: Construction firm Hellenic Technodomiki announced that the 3.12 billion drachma international placement of its 1.2 million ex-rights shares had been completed by Barclays de Zoete Wedd and Alpha brokerage.
"The distribution was completed at a price of 2,600 drachmas per share," it said. "Shares were allocated to major international and Greek institutions."
The shares were sold by some major shareholders who have stated that they will use the proceeds to participate in the rights issue.
Alpha Finance was the issue advisor and Alpha Credit Bank was the issue underwriter.
Hellenic Technodomiki got shareholder approval on Thursday for a 7.7 billion drachma rights issue planned for mid-May.
Rights will entitle shareholders to one new share per one outstanding at 1,400 drachmas.
Shares of Hellenic Technodomiki went ex-rights and ex-dividend today.
The company will pay a dividend per share of 200 drachmas for fiscal 1996 versus 170 drachmas a year earlier.
Hellenic Technodomiki posted 1996 pretax profits of 3.25 billion drachams, up 32 percent on 1995. Its turnover rose 14 percent to 24.36 billion drachmas.
Its orderbook of uncompleted projects exceeds 70 billion drachmas, said its management on Thursday.
